PROFILE::diameter
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned DIAMETER profile.

SYNOPSIS
       PROFILE::diameter ATTR

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned DIAMETER profile.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the current value of the specified setting in an assigned DIAMETER profile.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.0.0 --First introduced the command.
